blind_target.title: Studies of similarity
blind_target.evidence_quote: In Study 2 we attempted to replicate Experiment 4 in Tversky and Gati ( 1978 ) which was reported in Tversky ( 1977 ) as the second study providing support for the diagnosticity effect.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Thus, as the meta-analysis indicates, without eliminating possible substitution effects we replicate the original findings by Tversky ( 1977 ) and Tversky and Gati ( 1978 ). However, eliminating substitution effects strongly reduces the observed differences between conditions with averages of 2.89% (1a), 17.5% (1b), −1.21% (2a), and 1.24% (2b). Overall the size of differences between conditions, when substitution effects were eliminated, clustered around zero (see Figure 6 ).
